evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Creation of games is present and complementary capabilities (browse, delete, transcripts) exist in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Inviting via URL is supported and complemented by a join story for estimators (PP-029).

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round by entering items is supported and item add/edit/delete/select stories exist (PP-006, PP-007, PP-008, PP-005).

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Viewing session items is consistent with item management stories; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selecting items is supported alongside add/edit/delete and browsing capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Item creation is present and paired with edit/delete and selection stories.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items is backed by creation (PP-006) and deletion (PP-008), so no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deletion is paired with item creation and editing stories, so the set is complete for item lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Displaying estimates is supported by estimation and display stories; no missing complementary capability evident.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an average is supported by stories that collect and show estimates; complementary estimate-entry and transcript features exist.

evaluations.evidence: estimate field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Auto-fill behavior is implementable given the existing estimation and display stories; no missing capability shown in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Entering agreed estimate complements acceptance and round flow stories; complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimating previous stories is supported by scroll-back and transcript stories (PP-039, PP-017).

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Import and other story-creation options exist (PP-015) and are not missing complementary functionality.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Quick story entry is provided and complements other item management stories; no missing capability detected.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is supported by game creation, transcripts and exports; no required complementary capability is absent.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Transcript viewing is supported and complemented by export and storage stories (PP-018, PP-019).

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export functionality is paired with transcript storage and browsing; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements transcript and storage features; no missing related capability evident.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion is present and complementary to game creation and browsing (PP-001, PP-016).

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is provided and complemented by login, change and delete account stories (PP-022, PP-023, PP-024).

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is supported and paired with account creation and password reminder (PP-021, PP-026).

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account modification is consistent with create and delete account stories; complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is present and paired with account creation; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a present requirement and does not expose a missing complementary capability in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is supported; account creation includes an email address (PP-021) so complementary data exists.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2...} or {0,1,2...}
evaluations.rationale: Card set selection is self-contained and does not expose a missing complementary requirement.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Inviting multiple estimators is supported and complements the join story (PP-029).

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Joining via name complements invitation creation (PP-002); required identity capture is present.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Displaying the current item is supported by item management and round-start stories.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Session item overview aligns with item listing and browsing stories; no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Displaying who has estimated is supported by join/identity stories (PP-029) and requires no absent complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simultaneous reveal is consistent with estimation flow stories; complementary data collection stories are present.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Estimate change during a draw is supported by the draw lifecycle stories; no missing complementary capability.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates is supported by transcript and history stories (PP-017, PP-039); no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Showing per-estimator estimates is supported by identity and estimate collection stories; no missing requirement detected.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Timer start and shared visibility are self-contained behaviors; complementary reset behavior is present (PP-038).

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic reset complements the timer start story (PP-037); no missing functionality.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Scroll-back history is supported by transcripts and export features; no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering requirement is implementable and self-contained; no missing complementary story apparent.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This overlaps with estimate-change stories (PP-034) and is supported by the draw lifecycle; no missing capability.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: The backlog requires displaying a thumbnail photo but contains no story to add/upload/set a photo/avatar (no account-avatar or upload capability), so the complementary capability to supply the photo is missing.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: A non-functional requirement for standards compliance does not expose a missing complementary story in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary requirement is self-contained; no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance/DB tuning story is internal and does not reveal a missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Cross-browser compatibility is a non-functional requirement and does not expose missing functional capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility requirement is non-functional; no complementary functional capability is missing from the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance responsiveness is a quality requirement and does not reveal a missing complementary functional story.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a platform/internationalization requirement; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is a UX requirement and does not indicate missing functional stories.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page requirement is complementary to many stories but does not expose a missing functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: The backlog requires non-identifiable storage for research, but many stories record identifiable participant names/avatars and show who estimated (PP-029, PP-032, PP-036, PP-042) and exports/transcripts (PP-017, PP-018, PP-019) exist with no complementary anonymization or anonymized-export story; the capability to anonymize or export non-identifiable results is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Requesting metrics is a self-contained analytic feature; no necessary complementary capability is evidently missing from the backlog (data storage and transcripts exist).
